It reports on_chain.zeph_reserve_atoms 5242494971858117907 (5,242,494.971858117907 ZEPH) and zsd_circ_atoms 339523561042720755 (339,523.561042720755 ZSD). The scanner documentation identifies zeph_in_reserve as ZEPH locked in the DJED reserve. The complete single-asset reserve remains one 100% ZEPH slice, unchanged from the October 17 snapshot; the snapshot's reserve_ratio 1.845614 is a coverage observation rather than a composition weight, replacing the October 17 ratio of 3.819930 as reserve amounts, circulating ZSD, and ZEPH spot moved. This review establishes reserve composition from the issuer's itemized native reserve snapshot and documented asset identity. It does not assert an independently pinned daemon read, an independent attestation, a liquidation horizon, or legal custody protection.
